card.name: Inside split-up words before a stem
card.fires_on: Short word pieces inside a word that is split oddly, often after a hyphen, such as -admin in co-administered or -d in post-dose. The rest of the word follows.

modes.label: Hyphenated prefix joins
modes.description: A hyphen plus a short piece after co-, post-, or re- where the word continues.
modes.example: When omeprazole is co<<-admin>>istered with darunavir/

modes.label: Odd splits in names and terms
modes.description: Single letters or short pieces inside names or medical words that are cut mid-way.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of Troph<<A>>mine® is 2 to 2
